title: Nordic Smoked Salmon & Cottage Cheese Bowl
historical_context: A refreshing high-protein Nordic breakfast combining high-protein curd cottage cheese with cold-smoked salmon and fresh dill.
instructions: Spoon high-protein low-fat cottage cheese into serving bowls.
Arrange folded cold-smoked salmon slices alongside the cottage cheese.
Top with sliced cucumber, capers, and a generous sprinkle of fresh dill and cracked black pepper.
Serve with a slice of dark rye crispbread.

title: Moroccan Spiced Ground Beef Tagine
historical_context: Kefta tagine featuring spiced beef meatballs simmered in a rich tomato and bell pepper sauce, traditionally topped with poached eggs.
instructions: Mix ground beef with cumin, paprika, coriander, minced garlic, and chopped parsley, then roll into small meatballs.
Sauté diced onions and sliced bell peppers in olive oil in a skillet, then add crushed tomatoes and spices.
Simmer meatballs in the tomato sauce for 20 minutes until cooked through.
Crack eggs directly into the sauce during the last 5 minutes, cover, and let poach.

title: Greek Chicken Souvlaki Wraps
historical_context: Iconic Greek street food featuring marinated chicken skewers wrapped in flatbread with homemade tzatziki and tomatoes.
instructions: Marinate cubed chicken breast in olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper for 30 minutes.
Thread onto skewers and grill over high heat for 12-15 minutes until fully cooked.
Warm high-protein flatbreads or pita pockets.
Assemble wraps with chicken, sliced tomatoes, red onions, and a generous dollop of tzatziki.

title: Argentinian Grilled Flank Steak (Churrasco)
historical_context: Lean, nutrient-dense flank steak grilled over high heat and paired with a vibrant herbaceous chimichurri sauce.
instructions: Season flank steak liberally with coarse sea salt and black pepper.
Grill over high heat for 4-6 minutes per side for medium-rare, ensuring a perfect sear.
Finely chop fresh parsley, cilantro, oregano, garlic, red pepper flakes, and mix with olive oil and red wine vinegar for chimichurri.
Slice steak thinly against the grain and top with chimichurri sauce.

title: Thai Chicken & Basil Stir-Fry (Pad Krapow Gai)
historical_context: A fiery, protein-packed street food favorite featuring minced chicken tossed with garlic, bird's eye chilies, and holy basil.
instructions: Mince garlic and bird's eye chilies together in a mortar and pestle.
Heat oil in a wok and stir-fry the garlic-chili paste until aromatic.
Add ground chicken and break apart, cooking until browned.
Stir in fish sauce, soy sauce, oyster sauce, and a pinch of sugar, then toss in fresh basil leaves until wilted.
